summary.text: Mary-Dulany James is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 34 in Harford County who has held the seat since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she previously served in the House of Delegates from 1998 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Mary-Dulany James was born in Baltimore and attended Havre de Grace High School.
She earned a B.S. in psychology with honors from the University of Maryland, College Park, in 1981 and a law degree with honors from the University of Maryland School of Law.
James was admitted to the Maryland bar in 1986 and clerked for Judge Edward S. Northrop of the U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland.
She practiced at Whiteford, Taylor & Preston, Venable, Baetjer and Howard, and Hodes, Ulman, Pessin & Katz, and has been a founding partner of James & Zink since 2011.
James served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 1998 to 2015.
She assumed office in the state Senate on January 11, 2023, succeeding Bob Cassilly.
According to the General Assembly website, she serves on the Executive Nominations Committee and the Judicial Proceedings Committee.
